title: Exercise Runner
description: Guided single-technique practice — pick a technique, predict the outcome, run hunt SPL, apply the triage runbook, then reveal the explanation. Data-driven from exercise_content.csv lookup.

input_prediction.title: Before you run — what do you expect?

input_custom_spl.title: SPL Query (editable — leave blank to use lookup default)

options.query: | inputlookup exercise_content | search learning_tier="$tier_filter$" OR "$tier_filter$"="*" | stats count as tier_total | appendcols [ search index=acme_agentic_telemetry sourcetype="otel:agentic:json" earliest=$global_time.earliest$ latest=$global_time.latest$ technique_id=AML.* | lookup exercise_content technique_id OUTPUT learning_tier | search learning_tier="$tier_filter$" OR "$tier_filter$"="*" | stats dc(technique_id) as tier_observed ] | eval tier_observed=coalesce(tier_observed,0) | eval progress=round(100*tier_observed/tier_total,1) | table tier_observed tier_total progress
| inputlookup exercise_content | search learning_tier="$tier_filter$" OR "$tier_filter$"="*" | table technique_id, title | sort learning_tier, technique_id
| inputlookup exercise_content | search technique_id="$selected_technique$" | head 1 | table instructions_text, execution_mode, expected_outcome, chart_type, spl_query

| inputlookup exercise_content | search technique_id="$selected_technique$" | head 1 | eval effective_spl=if(isnull("$custom_spl$") OR len("$custom_spl$")<8, spl_query, "$custom_spl$") | fields effective_spl | map maxsearches=1 search="$effective_spl$"

| inputlookup exercise_content | search technique_id="$selected_technique$" | head 1 | eval feedback=case(expected_outcome="VARIES", "You predicted " + "$learner_prediction$" + ". This technique is honestly VARIES in the lab (small-model non-determinism or config-dependent controls).", "$learner_prediction$"="NOT_SURE", "No prediction committed — typical expected outcome: " + expected_outcome + ".", "$learner_prediction$"=expected_outcome, "You predicted " + "$learner_prediction$" + " — aligns with typical expected outcome (" + expected_outcome + ").", true(), "You predicted " + "$learner_prediction$" + "; this technique typically shows " + expected_outcome + ". Compare against control fields in results, not model text alone.") | table feedback
| inputlookup exercise_content | search technique_id="$selected_technique$" | head 1 | table triage_runbook_text
| inputlookup exercise_content | search technique_id="$selected_technique$" | head 1 | table explanation_text, framework_mapping, mitigation_text

| inputlookup exercise_content | search technique_id="$selected_technique$" | head 1 | eval effective_spl=if(isnull("$custom_spl$") OR len("$custom_spl$")<8, spl_query, "$custom_spl$") | fields effective_spl | map maxsearches=1 search="$effective_spl$" | stats count by agent.id | sort - count | head 10

| inputlookup exercise_content | search technique_id="$selected_technique$" | head 1 | eval effective_spl=if(isnull("$custom_spl$") OR len("$custom_spl$")<8, spl_query, "$custom_spl$") | fields effective_spl | map maxsearches=1 search="$effective_spl$" | timechart span=5m count

viz_progress.title: Progress — techniques with telemetry in window (best-effort)
